description: A design-token / theming standard. Static checks verify token definitions are present and that component styles contain no raw hex values. Runtime checks verify `[data-theme]`/`data-resolved-theme` applies, dark-mode toggles, and `var(--surface-*)` resolves. Auto-fix can scaffold a token file (safe) while raw-hex-to-token rewrites are report-only.

requirements.description: Static design-token checks must verify that token definitions are present and that component styles contain no raw hex color literals. A missing token file or a raw hex value in a component style must produce a Finding.
requirements.title: Static token checks

validation.notes: Missing token definitions produce a Finding
A raw hex color literal in a component style produces a no-raw-hex Finding
Token references via var(--*) do not trigger raw-hex Findings
Run ui-health against a scenario with a hardcoded hex color and confirm the raw-hex Finding is emitted
The design-token static standard enforces tokenized colors across scenarios

requirements.description: Runtime theming checks must verify `[data-theme]`/`data-resolved-theme` applies, dark-mode toggles correctly, and `var(--surface-*)` variables resolve. A safe auto-fixer scaffolds the token file; raw-hex-to-token rewrites must be report-only (risky).
requirements.title: Runtime theme-apply + report-only raw-hex

validation.notes: Runtime check confirms data-theme/data-resolved-theme applies and var(--surface-*) resolves
The token-file scaffold fixer is marked safe and is idempotent; raw-hex-to-token is report-only
Dark-mode toggle failure surfaces as a runtime theming Finding
Run ui-health runtime checks and confirm theme apply and surface-var resolution are validated against the live UI
Theming runtime checks plus safe token scaffolding round out the design-token standard while keeping risky rewrites report-only

title: design-token / theming standard
